title: [review] project-LICHEN-636h.3: DispatchMessage log reads rxOneShot after mutation
description: In SX1262.cs DispatchMessage at line 766 (RX_PACKET case), the debug log `this.Log(LogLevel.Debug, "RX_PACKET {0} bytes (async) oneShot={1}", rxLen, rxOneShot)` reads rxOneShot after lines 759-762 may have already set it to false (when rxOneShot was true). The log will always show `oneShot=False` for one-shot RX_PACKETs, making diagnostic output misleading. Fix: capture rxOneShot value before the mutation and log the captured value.
